field: Fuel margin (cents per gallon, excluding credit card fees)
fiscal_calendar: Fiscal year runs May 1 through April 30; Q1 ends July 31, Q2 October 31, Q3 January 31, and Q4 April 30.
notes: All 28 observations are company-reported quarterly figures; no missing quarter was estimated.
The fuel category excludes wholesale fuel and terminal activity, which Casey's reports in Other.
Supply/RIN fields are blank because this backtest targets Casey's disclosed retail fuel margin only.
Fikes was acquired during F2025 Q3 and added 198 stores plus a wholesale network; the resulting exposure change is a disclosed structural break.
The F2020-F2022, F2022-F2024, and F2024-F2026 annual-result tables overlap at F2022 and F2024 and agree on the quarterly values.

sources.purpose: Fiscal-calendar, footprint, retail/wholesale separation, and Fikes acquisition verification
